title: Zesty Herbal Slovakian Wonton Dumplings
description: A flexitarian friendly Slovakian dish featuring wonton skin and stir-fry, filled with herbal ingredients, making it a pillowy and indulgent treat. This recipe combines the freshness of herbs with the comfort of dumplings.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chopped parsley, dill, garlic, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add sliced mushrooms to the bowl and stir to combine.
Lay a wonton skin on a flat surface and place a tablespoon of the herbal mixture in the center.
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wonton skin.
Fold the wonton skin into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat with the remaining wonton skins and filling.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot with a drizzle of soy sauce.
